moves.name: MLA decode by absorbing K/V projection weights into latent-cache attention
moves.description: Decode projects q_nope with w_kc, attends over the kv_lora_rank+RoPE latent cache as a single-KV-head MQA problem, then de-absorbs the value result with w_vc. This avoids materializing per-head K/V and lets generic MQA/GQA decode kernels run over compressed latent states.
moves.problem_solved: Per-head K/V expansion and cache bandwidth in MLA decode.
semantic_preconditions: Model exposes MLA dimensions kv_lora_rank and qk_rope_head_dim.
Weight absorption is used for decode/extend paths, not all prefill cases.
hardware_preconditions: CUDA/HIP device capable of batched GEMM and selected attention backend.
framework_preconditions: RadixAttention receives num_kv_heads=1 and v_head_dim=kv_lora_rank for latent-cache decode.

assumptions.assumption: Compressed latent cache is shaped as one KV head of kv_lora_rank+RoPE dimensions.
assumptions.excerpt: num_kv_heads=1, v_head_dim=self.kv_lora_rank

assumptions.assumption: Offline transposition preserves the absorbed-value GEMM semantics.
assumptions.excerpt: self_attn.w_vc = w_vc.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()

moves.performance_evidence: PR #1261 transposes absorbed weights offline; no numeric result in checked diff.
moves.correctness_evidence: Registry lists test/srt/test_mla.py and test/registered/mla/test_mla.py.

biography.first_appearance: SGLang PR #905 / e1eae1fd15ed (2024-08-05) in deepseek_v2.py; pickaxe first hit is e1eae1fd15 for w_kc/w_vc.
biography.problem: Avoids per-head K/V expansion and cache bandwidth in MLA decode by treating latent cache as one KV head and absorbing/de-absorbing projection weights.
biography.preconditions: MLA exposes kv_lora_rank and qk_rope_head_dim; latent cache is stored as kv_lora_rank+RoPE; RadixAttention/attention backend accepts num_kv_heads=1 and v_head_dim=kv_lora_rank.
biography.survival: conceptual + textual evidence: original file moved/refactored, but cutoff git grep finds w_kc/w_vc in forward_mla.py; v0.2.9 absent and v0.2.13 present.

moves.name: MHA-style MLA prefill without weight absorption
moves.description: Long prefill/extend without cached prefix uses the normal kv_b_proj path, materializing k_nope and v before attention. Decode and prefix-bearing extend remain on the absorbed path, separating throughput-prefill from memory-bound decode.
moves.problem_solved: Absorbed MLA was not optimal or convenient for full prefill where dense MHA-style computation is available.

moves.name: Split-KV flash-decoding with LSE merge and dynamic per-batch split counts
moves.description: The Triton decode kernel splits a sequence's KV range across CTAs, stores per-split partial values and log-sum-exp, then a second stage merges them with online-softmax correction. Later dynamic-workload changes load num_kv_splits per batch and launch to max_kv_splits so short and long requests can share a batch more efficiently.
moves.problem_solved: Long-context decode underutilization and load imbalance across heterogeneous batch sequence lengths.
semantic_preconditions: KV indices/indptr define each request's cached token span.
Merge stage receives per-split LSE values.
hardware_preconditions: Triton target supports the selected BLOCK_N/BLOCK_H launch geometry.
framework_preconditions: max_kv_splits workspace is allocated and num_kv_splits is valid per batch item.

assumptions.assumption: Splits cover the sequence by ceil-dividing each request length and skipping empty splits.
assumptions.excerpt: kv_len_per_split = tl.cdiv(tl.cdiv(cur_batch_seq_len, kv_splits), MIN_BLOCK_KV)
